description: Kernel-mystery probe (T-1778 round 3, erfc-probes): dense grids (600 points, step 0.0005, x = c - 0.15 + 0.0005j + 6.18E-8) around ten change-point candidates c of the ERFC drift found in kmyst-erfc-driftmap, to tell real jumps (branch or term-count changes) from steep smooth error-curve slopes. A = x, B = ERFC.PRECISE(x), C = EXP(-(x*x)).
